title: Create src/lib/backends/claude.ts — Claude direct backend
description: Implement the AgentBackend interface for Claude CLI (direct, no docker). Spawns Claude with the opus model and the prompt. Validates that the claude binary is in PATH.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/backends/claude.ts exists and exports a ClaudeBackend implementing AgentBackend
Missing claude binary throws a descriptive error

steps.details: Create the file mirroring the structure of copilot.ts. Import spawn from child_process, execSync from child_process. Import types from types.ts.
Check for 'claude' in PATH: `try { execSync('which claude', { stdio: 'ignore' }) } catch { throw new Error('claude CLI not found in PATH. Install Claude Code from https://claude.ai/download') }`

spawn(prompt: string, options: BackendOptions): ChildProcess { // check binary; return spawn('claude', ['--model', 'opus', '-p', prompt], { cwd: options.cwd || process.cwd(), stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }) }
Same parseOutput as copilot — text lines. Export: export const claudeBackend: AgentBackend = { name: 'Claude (direct)', spawn, parseOutput }

technicalNotes: claude CLI is part of Claude Code — the user needs to have it installed and authenticated
